changelog: Privacy: provider tokens, SSH keys, the security token and PC pairing secrets are now encrypted with a key kept in the Android Keystore
Privacy: Android cloud backup and device-to-device transfer are turned off for the app and its Linux environment
Privacy: automatic app and plugin update checks are off by default; turn them on in Settings → About → Software Updates
Privacy: the Network Inspector no longer records Authorization, cookies or API keys
Security: the Linux rootfs download is checked against a pinned SHA-256 before it is extracted
Security: update and Termux:X11 APKs are checked against the expected signing certificate before the installer opens
X11: corrected the Termux:X11 download link and companion package name; the APK is signature-checked before installing
Removed the leftover TelemetryDeck device id and timing file from older installs
